corrections.reason: The Amharic gloss for the Ge'ez 'እንተ ኀሠሥዋ' (which they sought) is 'የሿት' (from ሻ, to seek/desire). The bottom horizontal bar of ሿ was misread as the right-leg of ሺ.
Same Amharic gloss 'የሿት' (which the prophets sought, rendering 'ኀሠሥዋ'), where ሿ was misread as ሺ.
Same Amharic gloss 'የሿት' (which the prophets sought), where the 7th/labiovelar-style bottom bar of ሿ was misread as ሺ.
In Classical Ge'ez, the subjunctive of አስተፋነወ (to escort/send off, glossed below as ሸኙኝ) is 'ያስተፋኑ' with 4th-order ፋ, which is clearly visible in the print.
The printed Ge'ez text clearly reads 'ሐራ ፡ መልአኩ' (the host/troop of his angel), with 1st-order ሐ and 2nd-order ኩ.

In this citation of Genesis 24:22 ('ወእምዘረወዩ አግማሊሁ ነሥአ ኢያሱር አእኑገ ዘወርቅ'), the singular verb is 'ነሥአ' and the subject name is 'ኢያሱር' (Eliezer in the Ge'ez Old Testament); the top bar of ሱ was misread as ቡ.
